name: Lyo.Scientific
tagline: Scientific domain models, reference datasets, SI-oriented unit helpers, and formula discovery on top of `Lyo.Mathematics`.
description:
Scientific domain models, reference datasets, SI-oriented unit helpers, and formula discovery on top of [ `Lyo.Mathematics`](../../Mathematics/Lyo.Mathematics/README.md). Numerical formulas that operate on these types are in [ `Lyo.Scientific.Functions`](../Lyo.Scientific.Functions/README.md) (F#).

Target frameworks: `netstandard2.0`, `net10.0`

sections.title: `ScientificConstants`
sections.text: Named CODATA-style double constants (SI): standard gravity, gravitational constant, speed of light, vacuum permittivity, universal gas constant, Planck constant, Boltzmann, Avogadro, elementary charge, plus `Tau` and `Pi`. Use for physics formulas (see `PhysicsFunctions` in `Lyo.Mathematics.Functions`).

sections.title: Units (`Lyo.Scientific.Units`)
rows: Exponents for L, M, T, I, Θ, N, J (luminous intensity); `Dimensionless`.
Adds SI values after the dimension check.
Scales by a metric prefix multiplier.
G, T, k, M, da, h, c, d, μ, m, p, n prefixes.

sections.title: Astronomy (`Lyo.Scientific.Astronomy`)
rows: Mass, name, radii, sidereal orbit/rotation, semi-major axis, mean surface temperature, rings, moon count.
Mass, name, luminosity, radius, surface temperature.
Parent planet, name, radius, mass, orbital period, semi-major axis.
Host `Star`, name, `OrbitalElements`, optional radius/mass, habitability flag.

sections.title: Chemistry (`Lyo.Scientific.Chemistry`)
rows: Symbol, atomic number, name, optional atomic mass.
Mass number, symbol, atomic mass, optional natural abundance %.
Relative atomic weights for molar mass estimates.

sections.title: Engineering (`Lyo.Scientific.Engineering`)
items: **Materials / catalogs.** `MaterialProperty` (specific heat, density, conductivity, optional viscosity, expansion, Young's modulus, yield, fracture toughness). `EngineeringMaterials.Common` (Water, Air, Aluminum, Steel, Copper).

sections.title: Workflow and discovery helpers
rows: Curated `FormulaDescriptor` entries pointing at `Lyo.Scientific.Functions` (reaction balance, molar mass, orbital period, fatigue life, oblique shock, …).

`InAstronomicalUnits(this PlanetaryBody)`, `MolarMassEstimate(this ChemicalCompound)` (element weights × counts), `GetMaterial(this string name)` (case-insensitive match in `EngineeringMaterials.Common`).
